name: PDF Tinkerer
blurb: This desktop app reads and writes PDF documents.
description:
This desktop app reads and writes PDF documents. It was created for a small copy shop in Germany. Features of this application are:

• Clone two or more PDF pages on one PDF page

• Extract images from a PDF file

• Export PDF pages to JPG and PNG images

• Glue two PDF pages together to print them with a plotter

• Add, move and delete pages in a PDF document

• Create a booklet of a PDF document, that you can print later

• Create a PDF document from JPG and PNG images, with one new page per image

• Available in the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
